+# TODO List for Zoom Clone UI Improvements
+
+## 1. Fix UI Color Mismatches
+- Review all components for consistent dark theme colors (#2a2a2a, #4c535b, etc.)
+- Update any mismatched colors in MeetingRoom, MeetingSetup, Loader, etc.
+
+## 2. Add Chat Box to Meeting Room
+- Integrate chat functionality into MeetingRoom.tsx
+- Use Stream SDK or custom chat component
+- Position chat box appropriately in the UI
+
+## 3. Improve UI and Smooth Transitions
+- Add CSS transitions for buttons, layouts, etc.
+- Ensure smooth animations in globals.css
+
+## 4. Add Warning in Meeting Setup
+- In MeetingSetup.tsx, add warning text about host controls
+
+## 5. Settings for Participants (Camera/Mic)
+- Modify MeetingSetup.tsx to require camera and mic permissions
+- Add settings UI for participants
+
+## 6. Host Controls
+- Implement logic for host to control unmuted/uncammed participants
+- Ensure only host can see/hear forced participants
+
+## 7. Improve Loader UI ✅
+- Enhanced Loader.tsx with dark container, better color, loading text, and transitions
+
+## 8. Change Toasts to Match Signin Page Style
+- Update toast.tsx to modern, rounded style
+
+## 9. Add Smooth Animations and Transitions
+- Update globals.css with smooth transitions
+- Add animations to components
+
+## 10. Code Cleanup
+- Remove unused code
+- Fix linting errors
+- Improve readability
+
+## 11. Testing
+- Run the app
+- Test all features
+- Resolve errors

# TODO List for Zoom Clone UI Improvements

## 1. Fix UI Color Mismatches
- Review all components for consistent dark theme colors (#2a2a2a, #4c535b, etc.)
- Update any mismatched colors in MeetingRoom, MeetingSetup, Loader, etc.

## 2. Add Chat Box to Meeting Room
- Integrate chat functionality into MeetingRoom.tsx
- Use Stream SDK or custom chat component
- Position chat box appropriately in the UI

## 3. Improve UI and Smooth Transitions
- Add CSS transitions for buttons, layouts, etc.
- Ensure smooth animations in globals.css

## 4. Add Warning in Meeting Setup
- In MeetingSetup.tsx, add warning text about host controls

## 5. Settings for Participants (Camera/Mic)
- Modify MeetingSetup.tsx to require camera and mic permissions
- Add settings UI for participants

## 6. Host Controls
- Implement logic for host to control unmuted/uncammed participants
- Ensure only host can see/hear forced participants

## 7. Improve Loader UI
- Enhance Loader.tsx with better design (e.g., custom spinner, progress)

## 8. Change Toasts to Match Signin Page Style
- Update toast.tsx to modern, rounded style

## 9. Add Smooth Animations and Transitions
- Update globals.css with smooth transitions
- Add animations to components

## 10. Code Cleanup
- Remove unused code
- Fix linting errors
- Improve readability

## 11. Testing
- Run the app
- Test all features
- Resolve errors
